results.title: Doughnut shows top 10 brands + Others slice with callouts and legend

steps.title: Given the SOV doughnut chart is rendered with data containing more than 10 brands
When the chart finishes rendering
Then the doughnut shows exactly the top 10 brands by SOV descending plus one Others slice aggregating all remaining share
And each arc >= ~2% displays an outside percentage callout
And arcs with a value below ~2% have their callout hidden but their brand still appears in the legend
And a bottom-centered legend lists each brand with a color dot, name, and bold SOV percentage ordered by SOV desc with Others last

results.notes: Toyota (more than 10 brands): 11 arcs = top 10 by SOV desc + Others 24%; callouts outside each arc (14/13/10/9/7/6/5/4/4/4/24 %); legend bottom-centred, colour dot + name + bold %, SOV desc with Others last. Step 5 (< ~2 % callout hidden) not exercised by Toyota data (smallest top-10 arc 4 %) - verified on Decathlon b6c8b664, France, Gemini only, Last 7 days: ASICS 1.82 % and Deuter 1.77 % have no callout but stay in the legend (extra screenshot step5_small-arcs). Filters restored.

results.title: Empty state displayed when scope has no responses

steps.title: Given a user is on the Overview or a Category view where the selected scope returns no responses
When the SOV card would render
Then the SOV card displays an empty state message such as No data to show or Adjust your filters or widen the date range to see this metric inside the card
And no misleading 0% value is displayed

results.notes: No real zero-response scope is reachable on staging (calendar disables days without a report; the only empty API scopes use engines not configured on the analysis, whose toggles are disabled). Empty scope simulated client-side by intercepting overview/sov-distribution with {"brands":[]} (read-only). Result: card keeps its header and shows "No data to show" + "Adjust your filters or widen the date range to see this metric"; no 0 % value, no empty doughnut. UI behaviour verified; real empty-scope precondition not reproducible -> PARTIAL.

results.title: Error state shows reload button that re-fetches inline

steps.title: Given the SOV chart data fails to load (network error or server error)
When the card renders after the failure
Then the card keeps its Share of Voice header and shows an error state with a crossed-chart icon, Couldn't load this chart message, helper text, and a Reload button
When the user clicks the Reload button
Then the chart re-fetches its data inline without triggering a full page reload

results.notes: Failure simulated (test data) by answering overview/sov-distribution with HTTP 500. Card keeps "Share of Voice" header and shows crossed-chart icon, "Couldn't load this chart", "Something went wrong while loading this chart." and a Reload button. After removing the interception and clicking Reload: only the sov-distribution request was re-sent, no main-frame navigation, window marker kept (no full reload), doughnut re-rendered "Toyota 14%" (screenshots step4_reload / step5_then).
